integrity: Complete graph/face enumeration, acyclic discrete-Morse certificate, exact integral boundary recursion, and two independent modular boundary-rank checks are supplied as a standalone program; mathematical proof requires standard discrete Morse and CW attaching-map theorems.
scientific_limitations: One explicitly defined twenty-vertex graph at one intrinsic Čech scale; no theorem about other scales or families. An unindexed equivalent computation cannot be excluded.
title: Scale-three Čech homotopy of the dodecahedral graph
